title: Number of Islands
summary: Grid of land/water cells; count the separate land masses connected horizontally or vertically.

title: Rotting Oranges
summary: Grid of fresh and rotten fruit; each minute rot spreads to neighbours. How many minutes until none are fresh, or -1?

title: Word Ladder
summary: Turn a start word into an end word changing one letter at a time, every step must be a dictionary word. Fewest steps?

title: Clone Graph
summary: Given a node of a connected undirected graph, return a deep copy of the whole graph.
example: node 1 of edges 1-2, 2-3, 3-4, 4-1 -> a new node 1 of an identical but separate graph

title: Pacific Atlantic Water Flow
summary: Height map bordered by two oceans; find the cells from which water can flow downhill to both.
example: Pacific touches top/left edges, Atlantic bottom/right; heights [[1,2],[2,1]] -> [[0,1],[1,0]]

title: Shortest Path in Binary Matrix
summary: Binary grid; length of the shortest 8-directional clear path from top-left to bottom-right.

title: Network Delay Time
summary: Weighted directed edges between servers; time for a signal from one server to reach all of them.

title: Cheapest Flights within K Stops
summary: Flights with prices; cheapest route from A to B using at most K stopovers.

title: Critical Connections in a Network
summary: Servers connected by cables; list every cable whose removal disconnects part of the network.
example: n = 4, edges [[0,1],[1,2],[2,0],[1,3]] -> [[1,3]] (the triangle survives any one cut)

title: Course Schedule
summary: Courses with prerequisite pairs; can every course be completed?

title: Course Schedule II
summary: Courses with prerequisite pairs; return an order in which to take them all, or empty if impossible.

title: Alien Dictionary
summary: Words sorted in an unknown alphabet; deduce an ordering of the letters.
example: ["wrt","wrf","er","ett","rftt"] -> "wertf" (t before f, w before e, r before t, e before r)

title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
summary: Binary tree and two nodes in it; find the deepest node that has both as descendants.
example: root 3, children 5 and 1; 5's children 6 and 2. LCA(6, 2) = 5, LCA(6, 1) = 3, LCA(5, 2) = 5

title: Validate Binary Search Tree
summary: Decide whether a binary tree satisfies the search-tree ordering property everywhere.
example: [2,1,3] -> true; [5,1,4,null,null,3,6] -> false (3 sits in 5's right subtree but is smaller than 5)

title: Binary Tree Maximum Path Sum
summary: Node values may be negative; find the largest sum of any path between two nodes.

title: Diameter of Binary Tree
summary: Number of edges on the longest path between any two nodes of a binary tree.

title: Serialize and Deserialize Binary Tree
summary: Design encode/decode functions that turn a binary tree into a string and back.
example: tree [1,2,3,null,null,4,5] -> e.g. "1,2,#,#,3,4,#,#,5,#,#" -> the same tree back

title: All Nodes Distance K in Binary Tree
summary: Binary tree, a target node and K; return every node exactly K edges from the target.

title: Construct Binary Tree from Preorder and Inorder Traversal
summary: Rebuild a binary tree given two traversal orders of it.
example: preorder [3,9,20,15,7], inorder [9,3,15,20,7] -> tree 3 with left 9, right 20 (20's children 15, 7)

title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
summary: Return a binary tree's values grouped by depth, top to bottom.

title: Binary Tree Zigzag Level Order Traversal
summary: Values grouped by depth, alternating left-to-right and right-to-left per level.

title: Binary Tree Right Side View
summary: Values you would see looking at a binary tree from its right-hand side.

title: Vertical Order Traversal of a Binary Tree
summary: Group tree nodes by column (left to right), ordering ties by row then value.

title: Top K Frequent Elements
summary: Return the K values that occur most often in an integer array.

title: Top K Frequent Words
summary: Return the K most frequent words, ties broken alphabetically.

title: K Closest Points to Origin
summary: List of 2D points; return the K nearest to (0,0).

title: Reorganize String
summary: Rearrange a string so no two equal characters are adjacent, or report it can't be done.

title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
summary: Find the Kth largest value in an unsorted array.

title: Find Median from Data Stream
summary: Class that accepts numbers one at a time and can report the current median.

title: Task Scheduler
summary: CPU tasks labelled by letter with a cooldown between identical tasks; minimum total time slots.
example: tasks [A,A,A,B,B,B], cooldown n = 2 -> 8 (A B idle A B idle A B)

title: Meeting Rooms II
summary: Meeting time intervals; minimum number of rooms needed.
example: [[0,30],[5,10],[15,20]] -> 2 (the 0-30 meeting overlaps both others, which don't overlap each other)

title: Car Pooling
summary: Trips with passenger counts and pickup/drop-off points; can a car of given capacity do them all?
example: trips [[2,1,5],[3,3,7]] (people, from, to), capacity 4 -> false (5 people aboard between 3 and 5); capacity 5 -> true

title: Merge K Sorted Lists
summary: Combine K sorted linked lists into one sorted list.

title: Kth Smallest Element in a Sorted Matrix
summary: Matrix with sorted rows and columns; find the Kth smallest value.

title: Merge Intervals
summary: Collapse a list of intervals so none overlap.

title: Insert Interval
summary: Sorted non-overlapping intervals; insert a new one, merging where needed.

title: Non Overlapping Intervals
summary: Fewest intervals to remove so the rest don't overlap.
example: [[1,2],[2,3],[3,4],[1,3]] -> 1 (drop [1,3]; touching ends like [1,2],[2,3] don't count as overlap)

title: Employee Free Time
summary: Each employee's sorted busy intervals; find the finite free time common to all.
example: employee A busy [1,2],[5,6]; B busy [1,3]; C busy [4,10] -> [[3,4]]

title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
summary: Length of the longest run of a string with no repeated character.

title: Minimum Window Substring
summary: Shortest substring of S containing every character of T (with multiplicity).

title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
summary: Replace up to K characters; longest substring of one repeated letter achievable.
example: "AABABBA", k = 1 -> 4 (change one letter to get "AAAA" or "BBBB")

title: Sliding Window Maximum
summary: Maximum of every contiguous window of size K.

title: Find All Anagrams in a String
summary: Start indices in S of every substring that is a rearrangement of P.

title: 3Sum
summary: All unique triples in an array that add to zero.

title: Container with Most Water
summary: Vertical lines of various heights; pick two that hold the most water.

title: Trapping Rain Water
summary: Elevation bars; total rain water trapped between them.

title: Linked List Cycle II
summary: Return the node where a linked list's cycle begins, if any.

title: Happy Number
summary: Repeatedly sum the squares of digits; does it reach 1 or loop forever?

title: Reverse Linked List II
summary: Reverse the nodes of a linked list between positions left and right.

title: Reorder List
summary: Reorder L0,L1..Ln into L0,Ln,L1,Ln-1... in place.

title: Copy List with Random Pointer
summary: Deep copy a linked list whose nodes also point to an arbitrary other node.
example: nodes A->B->C where A.random = C, B.random = A -> new A'->B'->C' with A'.random = C', B'.random = A'

title: Search in Rotated Sorted Array
summary: Sorted array rotated at an unknown pivot; find a target in O(log n).

title: Find Peak Element
summary: Find any index whose value is greater than both neighbours, in O(log n).
example: [1,2,1,3,5,6,4] -> 1 or 5 (2 and 6 are both bigger than their neighbours)

title: Koko Eating Bananas
summary: Piles of items and H hours; minimum per-hour rate to finish them all in time.
example: piles [3,6,7,11], h = 8 hours -> 4 per hour (1+2+2+3 = 8 hours; 3 per hour needs 10)

title: Capacity to Ship Packages within D Days
summary: Package weights shipped in order; smallest ship capacity that delivers everything within D days.

title: LRU Cache
summary: Design a fixed-capacity key-value cache that evicts the least recently used entry; O(1) get/put.
example: capacity 2: put(1), put(2), get(1) -> found; put(3) evicts 2 (least recently used); get(2) -> -1

title: Min Stack
summary: Stack that also returns its current minimum in O(1).
example: push -2, push 0, push -3: getMin -> -3; pop; top -> 0, getMin -> -2

title: Time Based Key Value Store
summary: Key-value store where each set has a timestamp; get returns the value as of a given time.

title: Design Hit Counter
summary: Count hits received in the past 5 minutes, given increasing timestamps.
example: hits at 1, 2, 3, 300: getHits(300) -> 4; getHits(301) -> 3 (hit at 1 is now over 300 seconds old)

title: Design In-Memory File System
summary: In-memory file system supporting ls, mkdir, add content and read content by path.

title: LFU Cache
summary: Cache evicting the least frequently used key (ties: least recent); O(1) ops.
example: capacity 2: put(1), put(2), get(1) (1 used twice), put(3) evicts 2 (used least often)

title: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
summary: Implement insert, search and startsWith for a set of words.
example: insert("apple"): search("apple") -> true, search("app") -> false, startsWith("app") -> true

title: Search Suggestions System
summary: As each character of a search word is typed, suggest up to 3 lexicographically smallest matching products.

title: Word Search II
summary: Letter grid and a word list; find every word that can be traced through adjacent cells.
example: board rows "oaan" / "etae" / "ihkr" / "iflv", words [oath, pea, eat, rain] -> ["eat","oath"]

title: Two Sum
summary: Indices of the two numbers that add up to a target.

title: Group Anagrams
summary: Group words that are rearrangements of each other.

title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
summary: Length of the longest run of consecutive integers in an unsorted array, in O(n).

title: Subarray Sum Equals K
summary: Count contiguous subarrays (values may be negative) summing to K.

title: Reorder Data in Log Files
summary: Log lines with identifiers; order letter-logs by content then id, keep digit-logs in original order after them.
example: ["d1 8 1", "l1 art can", "d2 3 6", "l2 own kit", "l3 art zero"] -> ["l1 art can","l3 art zero","l2 own kit","d1 8 1","d2 3 6"]

title: Valid Parentheses
summary: Decide whether a string of brackets is properly nested and closed.

title: Daily Temperatures
summary: For each day, how many days until a warmer temperature.

title: Basic Calculator II
summary: Evaluate a string expression with + - * / and non-negative integers, no parentheses.

title: Decode String
summary: Expand an encoding like 3[a2[c]] into the full string.

title: Word Break
summary: Can a string be split into a sequence of dictionary words?

title: Coin Change
summary: Fewest coins of given denominations that make an amount.

title: Longest Increasing Subsequence
summary: Length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.

title: House Robber
summary: Max total from a row of values without taking two adjacent ones.

title: Maximal Square
summary: Binary matrix; area of the largest square made only of 1s.

title: Longest Palindromic Substring
summary: Longest substring that reads the same forwards and backwards.

title: Word Search
summary: Can a word be traced through horizontally/vertically adjacent cells of a letter grid without reuse?
example: board rows "ABCE" / "SFCS" / "ADEE": "ABCCED" -> true, "ABCB" -> false (would reuse the B)

title: Combination Sum
summary: All combinations of candidates (reusable) that sum to a target.

title: Generate Parentheses
summary: All well-formed strings of n pairs of brackets.

title: Subsets
summary: Return every subset of a set of distinct integers.

title: Letter Combinations of a Phone Number
summary: Every letter string a sequence of phone keypad digits could spell.

title: Permutations
summary: Every ordering of a list of distinct integers.

title: Jump Game
summary: Each value is the max jump length from there; can you reach the last index?
example: [2,3,1,1,4] -> true; [3,2,1,0,4] -> false (every route lands on the 0)

title: Gas Station
summary: Circular route of fuel stops and costs; which start lets you complete the loop?
example: gas [1,2,3,4,5], cost [3,4,5,1,2] -> 3 (start at index 3 and the tank never goes negative)

title: Number of Provinces
summary: Adjacency matrix of cities; count the directly-or-indirectly connected groups.

title: Accounts Merge
summary: Accounts as name plus emails; merge accounts sharing any email.
example: [John: a@x, b@x], [John: b@x, c@x], [Mary: m@x] -> [John: a@x, b@x, c@x], [Mary: m@x]

title: Redundant Connection
summary: A tree plus one extra edge; return the edge that creates the cycle.
example: edges [[1,2],[1,3],[2,3]] -> [2,3] (the last edge that closes the cycle)

title: Rotate Image
summary: Rotate an n x n matrix 90 degrees clockwise in place.

title: Spiral Matrix
summary: Return all matrix elements in clockwise spiral order.

title: Set Matrix Zeroes
summary: Wherever a cell is 0, zero its whole row and column, in place.

title: First Missing Positive
summary: Smallest missing positive integer in an unsorted array, O(n) time and O(1) space.

title: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array
summary: Array of n values in 1..n; return the values that never appear.

title: Russian Doll Envelopes
summary: Envelopes (w,h); most that nest strictly inside one another.

title: Single Number
summary: Every value appears twice except one; find it in O(1) space.

title: Pow(x, n)
summary: Compute x raised to an integer power efficiently.
